root_cause.text: In nd_async_device_register(), when device_add() fails, put_device(dev) is called before accessing dev->parent, which can free the device and lead to a use-after-free when subsequently dereferencing dev->parent.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the assignment of `parent = dev->parent` before any put_device(dev) call, ensuring the parent pointer is saved before the device might be freed. The CVE description states: "if device_add() results in an allocation failure the ref count of the device drops to 0 prior to the parent pointer being accessed. Thus resulting in use after free."
